name: Trackmania
notes: Trackmania.exe only starts Ubisoft Connect, which must start the real game. Under Wine here Ubisoft Connect spins at ~100% CPU on several processes (UbisoftGameLauncher, UplayService, UplayWebCore) and never shows a window or starts the game (launcher_log: StartReqError code 109). Not playable yet; likely needs the same Chromium wrapper trick as Steam for UplayWebCore.exe.
